question: Can a one-pass bottleneck/shape summary of the current rank-one carrier absorb the production birth-age association without enumerating H2?

new_online_fields.boundary_cut_edges: number of NN primal edges with one endpoint in a current rank-one carrier and the other endpoint vacant
new_online_fields.boundary_multicontact_sites: vacant sites incident to at least two essential-carrier edges
new_online_fields.boundary_contact_pairs: sum over vacant sites of choose(number of incident essential-carrier edges,2)
new_online_fields.core_vertices: vertices remaining after degree-below-two peeling of the occupied essential-carrier induced multigraph
new_online_fields.core_edges: essential-carrier induced edges whose endpoints both survive the same 2-core peel
new_online_fields.articulation_vertices: Tarjan articulation vertices in the occupied essential-carrier induced multigraph
new_online_fields.bridges: Tarjan bridges in the occupied essential-carrier induced multigraph

complexity_boundary: All new fields use one scan of current vertices/edges plus linear-time 2-core and Tarjan traversals. No configuration, adjacency list, or future insertion site is written to disk. H2 remains only the exact ceiling already implemented.
fundamental_cycle_boundary: A rank-one state has only one independent ambient deck direction. Two independent deck cycles become defined only after a future rank-two completion, so no future-conditioned shortest-cycle or overlap statistic enters this current-state pilot.

models.Mcheap: M0 plus the prior essential size/carrier and occupied/vacant frontier vector
models.Mshape: Mcheap plus boundary_cut_edges/N, boundary_multicontact_sites/(N-k0), boundary_contact_pairs/(N-k0), core_vertices/N, core_edges/N, articulation_vertices/N, bridges/N
models.MH2: M0 plus H2/(N-k0), retained only as the definition-level ceiling

primary_production_anchor: For each orientation add the fresh paired delta beta_Mshape-beta_M0 to the independent 2M production beta_M0. Add the full 2x2 production covariance and fresh paired-delta covariance. N325 and N425 remain separate evidence blocks.
primary_decision: The proxy absorbs the production association only if both size-level two-orientation anchored joint p-values are at least 0.01 and every anchored absolute slope retention is at most 0.25. Otherwise it fails as a common bottleneck state.
secondary: report each proxy coefficient and paired Mshape-Mcheap shift without model selection
fit the complete N325 Mshape geometry-only coefficient vector and transfer it without refitting to N425 residual age slopes
report MH2 calibration but do not count it as mechanism evidence
exact_gates: 2-core counts equal a direct iterative peel on tiny quotients
Tarjan articulation/bridge counts equal deletion-based tiny-graph oracles
boundary cut and contact-pair counts equal direct tiny enumeration
the existing virtual H2 exhaustive gate remains green
support_gate: at least 400 risk rows and 10 next exits per orientation; otherwise report underpowered
interpretation_boundary: Failure to absorb excludes only this compact one-pass shape vector. It does not prove intrinsic temporal memory, complete-state non-Markovianity, or absence of a more targeted bottleneck coordinate.
